blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) have emerged as a promising approach to mechanistic interpretability by decomposing language-model activations into sparse, potentially interpretable features. However, differences in design assumptions, evaluation objectives, and experimental settings complicate conclusions about their effectiveness. We present a critical survey of 138 studies on SAEs in natural language processing. Our contributions are fourfold: (1) we propose a task-grounded taxonomy connecting dictionary design, feature operations, and NLP functions; (2) we examine how sparsity allocation, geometry, data coverage, and inference affect feature recoverability; (3) we assess evidence for semantic interpretability, mechanistic faithfulness, and behavioral utility; and (4) we synthesize findings across multilingual processing, retrieval, reasoning, classification, and behavioral regulation, highlighting the roles of objectives, baselines, supervision, and intervention pipelines. Through comparative analyses of published results, we reconcile apparent disagreements, identify unresolved questions, and propose directions for more rigorous evaluation. An anonymous research register https://anonymous.4open.science/r/sae-research-register-C331/register.html accompanies the survey.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Sparse autoencoders encode model activations as sparse coefficients over a learned dictionary of feature directions ( Cunningham et al., 2024 ) . They make it possible to inspect concepts, compare representations, and intervene on internal variables at a finer granularity than whole layers or attention heads. Sparse interpretable sentence embeddings provide an earlier precedent ( Trifonov et al., 2018 ) ; transformer studies established useful feature decompositions ( Bricken et al., 2023 ; Cunningham et al., 2024 ) ; subsequent work scaled dictionaries and released reusable resources ( Templeton et al., 2024 ; Gao et al., 2025 ; He et al., 2024b ) . The scientific opportunity is now broader: can these coordinates explain how language is represented and processed, and can that understanding improve NLP systems?
blocks.zh: Sparse 自动编码器将代码模型激活作为稀释系数,凌驾于一个学习过的特征方向词典(Cunningham等人,2024年). 它们使得能够比整层或注意力头更细细地检查概念,比较表达,并干涉内部变量. Sparse可解释句嵌入提供了更早的先例(Trifonov等人,2018年);变压器研究建立了有用的特征分解(Bricken等人,2023年;Cunningham等人,2024年);随后的工作缩放词典并释放可重复使用的资源(Templeton等人,2024年;Gao等人,2025年;He等人,2024年b). 科学机会现在更为广泛:这些坐标能否解释语言是如何被表达和处理的,而这种理解能否改善NLP系统?

blocks.en: Answering this question requires separating four outcomes. Recoverability concerns whether an encoding procedure recovers the target latent structure, where that structure is specified. Semantic interpretability concerns whether a feature description makes discriminating predictions about activations or effects. Mechanistic faithfulness concerns whether an explanation identifies computations the original model uses. Behavioral utility concerns success on a stated task with its competing objectives. These outcomes can agree, but their definitions do not imply agreement.
blocks.zh: 回答这个问题需要将四个结果分开。 可收回性涉及编码程序是否恢复目标潜在结构,具体指明了这种结构。 语义解释性涉及特征描述是否对激活或效应作出歧视性预测. 机械的忠诚度涉及解释是否识别了原始模型使用的计算. 行为效用涉及一项既定任务的成功及其相互竞争的目标。 这些结果可以达成一致,但其定义并不意味着达成一致。

blocks.en: Consider language identity. Multilingual feature analyses use it to distinguish language-associated representations ( Deng et al., 2025 ) ; language steering seeks to induce a chosen output language ( Gurgurov et al., 2026 ) ; LangSAE removes it from pooled embeddings to improve multilingual retrieval ( Kim et al., 2026 ) . Grouping these studies simply as multilingual SAE applications hides an objective-dependent reversal: information useful for generation can be a nuisance for semantic retrieval. Conversely, grouping only by encoder architecture does not reveal this distinction at all.
blocks.zh: 考虑语言特征. 多语言特征分析用它来区分与语言相关的表达方式(Deng等人,2025年);语言引导试图诱导选择的输出语言(Gurgurov等人,2026年);LangSAE将其从集合嵌入中去除,以改善多语言检索(Kim等人,2026年). 简单地将这些研究分组为多语言的SAE应用隐藏了一种客观的反转:对生成有用的信息可能对语义检索造成麻烦. 反之,仅通过编码器架构进行分组,根本不显示这种区别.

blocks.en: Existing surveys provide complementary perspectives on SAEs and mechanistic interpretability. Shu et al. (2025) synthesize SAE architectures, training procedures, feature explanations, evaluation methods, and applications. Mueller et al. (2026a) organize NLP mechanistic interpretability around causal mediators and search methods, examining which computational units and analytical procedures support explanation, hypothesis testing, and model editing. Zhang et al. (2026a) connect localization and steering to improvements in alignment, capability, and efficiency, including SAE features, task-specific metrics, and checks for unintended effects. Building on these foundations, our survey examines how SAE construction and use jointly shape the comparability and interpretation of NLP findings.
blocks.zh: 现有的调查提供了对最高审计实体和机械解释性的补充观点。 舒等编. (2025)综合SAE架构,培训程序,特征解释,评价方法,以及应用. Mueller等人(2026年a)围绕因果调解和搜索方法组织NLP机械解释,检查哪些计算单位和分析程序支持解释,假说测试,模型编辑. Zhang等人(2026年a)将本地化和引导与调整、能力和效率方面的改进联系起来,包括SAE特性、特定任务衡量标准以及对意外影响的检查。 在这些基础上,我们的调查审查了SAE构建和使用如何共同形成NLP结论的可比性和解释。

blocks.en: This motivates three research questions. RQ1: Which design assumptions change what an SAE can recover? We compare allocation, geometry, data coverage, and inference under their stated objectives and theoretical assumptions (Section 3 ). RQ2: What evidence distinguishes an interpretable or useful feature from a faithful mechanism? We examine semantic tests, intervention controls, and counterexamples using a claim-specific rubric (Section 4 ). RQ3: Why do NLP studies reach different conclusions about SAE usefulness? We compare task objectives, supervision, and control pipelines, and reanalyse selected within-study results (Section 5 ).
blocks.zh: 这激发了三个研究问题。 RQ1: 哪些设计假设改变了SAE能够回收什么? 我们比较分配、几何学、数据覆盖情况,并比较其既定目标和理论假设的推论(第3节)。 RQ2:哪些证据将可解释或有用的特征与忠实机制区分开来? 我们用一个具体的索赔标题来审查语义测试、干预控制和反实例(第4节)。 RQ3:为什么NLP研究对SAE有用性得出不同结论?. 我们比较任务目标、监督和控制管道,并重新分析选定的学习结果(第5节)。

blocks.en: 3.3 Separating coverage from inference error
blocks.zh: 3.3 将覆盖范围与推断错误分开

blocks.en:
Even a suitable representation and budget cannot resolve every
failure. Specialized sampling and tilted risk improve access to
rare concepts ( Muhamed et al., 2025b ) , changing the training distribution and
emphasis of the objective. Weighted SAEs analyze recovery and
reweighting under an idealized tied-weight model ( Cui et al., 2026 ) ;
those assumptions delimit the result’s applicability to
language-model activations. Locally amortized inference addresses
a different limitation: a shared encoder can leave an optimization
gap relative to per-input sparse coding ( Sun et al., 2026 ) . Improving
that approximation does not establish that the reference codes
are the intended linguistic features. Thus data coverage, the
learning objective, and encoding accuracy require separate
comparisons.

blocks.en: Recovering sparse features leaves their explanatory role unresolved. RQ2 asks what distinguishes a meaningful or useful feature from a faithful account of model computation. A feature may predict sentiment, support sentiment steering, or mediate the model’s own sentiment decision; these claims require different tests. Table 1 organizes support for a specified claim and evaluation setting. Appendix D develops the assessment rules through worked claims and a causal counterexample.
blocks.zh: 恢复稀少的特征使得其解释性作用得不到解决。 RQ2询问一个有意义的或有用的特征与忠实的模型计算描述有什么区别. 一个特征可以预测情绪,支持情绪引导,或者调解模型自身的情绪决定;这些诉求需要不同的测试. 表1为特定索赔和评估设置提供了支持。 附 录 D通过行之有效的索赔和因果对照来制定评估规则。

blocks.en: 4.1 Testing the feature’s meaning
blocks.zh: 4.1 国家 测试特性的意义

blocks.en: A feature description is a hypothesis about its behavior. Input-oriented descriptions predict what elicits activation; output-oriented descriptions predict contributions to generation ( Gur-Arieh et al., 2025 ) . Automated explanation ( Paulo et al., 2024 ) , agentic testing ( Han et al., 2026 ) , and counterexample-guided revision ( Ma et al., 2025 ) make these hypotheses testable on held-out positives and hard negatives. The critical question is whether the description discriminates the intended property from alternatives. Descriptive collision tests whether one explanation also fits unrelated features ( McCann, 2026 ) ; contrastive stories, semantic/functional neighborhoods, and concept-separability tests examine complementary aspects of specificity ( Gulko et al., 2025 ; Mercorio et al., 2025 ; Fereidouni et al., 2026 ; Härle et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 特征描述是对它的行为的假设. 以投入为导向的描述预测引发激活的因素;以产出为导向的描述预测对生成的贡献(Gur-Arieh等人,2025年)。 自动解释(Paulo等人,2024年),代理测试(Han等人,2026年),以及反实例制导修正(Ma等人,2025年),使得这些假说可以在被搁置的阳性和硬性阴性上进行测试. 关键问题是,该描述是否将预期财产与替代财产区分开来。 描述性碰撞测试(McCann,2026年);对比性故事、语义/功能邻里和概念分离测试,审查特殊性的补充方面(Gulko等人,2025年;Mercorio等人,2025年;Fereidouni等人,2026年;Härle等人,2025年)。

blocks.en: The controls must preserve what the claim says should remain invariant. A grammatical feature should track the specified contrast across appropriate lexical controls; a lexical feature need not survive word substitution. Adversarial inputs test the limits of a description ( Li et al., 2026a ) , while randomized SAE components and randomized host models challenge different sources of apparent interpretability ( Korznikov et al., 2026 ; Heap et al., 2026 ) . In the latter comparison, similar aggregate scores in several tested settings show that those metrics need not distinguish learned computations from structure present without training ( Heap et al., 2026 ) . Cross-run consistency asks whether features recur across learned dictionaries ( Song et al., 2026 ) ; recurrence alone does not validate their meaning.
blocks.zh: 控制必须保留索赔所声称的应保持不变的内容。 一个语法特征应该通过适当的语法控制来跟踪指定的对比;一个语法特征不需要幸存词替换. 横向输入测试一个描述的限度(Li等人,2026a),而随机化的SAE元件和随机化的主机模型则挑战不同的表面解释源(Korznikov等人,2026年;Heap等人,2026年). 在后一种比较中,一些测试环境中的类似总分显示,这些衡量标准不需要将所学计算与未经培训的结构区分开来(Heap等人,2026年)。 交叉运行的一致性质问特征是否在学习过的词典中重复出现(Song et al., 2026);单是重复并不能验证其意义.

blocks.en: 4.2 Testing predictive and causal effects
blocks.zh: 4.2 测试预测和因果关系

blocks.en: A useful predictor need not identify a variable the source model uses. For a known target, SAE probes should be compared with supervised probes on the original activations, given matched information ( Kantamneni et al., 2025 ; Makelov et al., 2025 ) . For control, direct activation directions provide an alternative ( Gurgurov et al., 2026 ) . These comparisons test the benefit of the SAE representation for the chosen objective. A reusable feature vocabulary can still support exploratory discovery beyond a predefined prediction task ( Peng et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 一个有用的预测器不需要识别源模型使用的变量. 对于已知目标,应当将SAE探测器与原激活物上的受监督探测器进行比较,并给出相应的信息(Kantamneni等人,2025年;Makelov等人,2025年)。 就控制而言,直接激活方向提供了一个替代品(Gurgurov等人,2026年)。 这些比较检验了SAE代表对所选目标的好处。 一个可重复使用的特征词汇仍然可以支持探索性发现,超越预先确定的预测任务(Peng等人,2025年).

blocks.en: 4.3 Testing the proposed mechanism
blocks.zh: 4.3 (中文(简体) ). 测试拟议的机制

blocks.en: The gap is explicit in Makelov et al. (2024) . Their patching direction combines a concept-correlated component that is disconnected from the output with an ordinarily dormant, output-sensitive component. Patching transfers a signal between them and changes the answer through a route unused before intervention. The successful edit therefore fails to identify the natural mechanism; Appendix D.1 instantiates this counterexample. Conversely, redundant pathways can make a genuinely used feature dispensable under ablation. Necessity and sufficiency must consequently be interpreted relative to the tested interventions and contexts.
blocks.zh: 在Makelov等人(2024年)中,差距是明显的。 它们的补丁方向结合了一个与输出脱节的概念-cor相关组件和一个通常休眠的,对输出敏感的组件. 补丁在它们之间传递一个信号,通过干预前未使用的路径改变答案. 因此,成功的编辑无法识别自然机制;附录D.1即刻说明了这一反例。 反之,多余的路径可以使真正使用的特征在衰减下可以被消化。 因此,必须对照经过检验的干预措施和背景来解释必要性和充分性。

blocks.en: A circuit claim further specifies dependencies between features. Sparse feature circuits retain feature and error nodes and test task-relevant effects ( Marks et al., 2025 ) . Module-level interventions on coactivation groups ( Deng et al., 2026 ) and transport-based feature matching ( Cao et al., 2026 ) concern group effects and correspondence. Establishing a directed circuit also requires tests of the proposed downstream dependencies; edge attribution helps select candidates for those tests. Attention-output features, formal languages, and Othello models provide distinct computational testbeds whose scope must accompany the interpretation ( Kissane et al., 2024 ; Menon et al., 2024 ; He et al., 2024a ) . Neurons, heads, key–value features, and functional dictionaries offer alternative units for the computational account ( O’Neill and Bui, 2024 ; Arora et al., 2026 ; Ye et al., 2025 ; Shafran et al., 2026 ; Dunefsky et al., 2024 ) ; the comparison should establish what the SAE basis adds.
blocks.zh: 电路索赔还具体规定了各特征之间的依赖关系。 Sparse特性电路保留了特性和误差节点以及测试任务相关效果(Marks等人,2025年). 关于协同组的模块级干预(Deng等人,2026年)和基于交通的特征匹配(Cao等人,2026年)涉及群体效应和通信. 建立定向电路还需要测试拟议的下游依赖性;边缘归属有助于选择这些测试的候选人。 注意输出特征、正式语言和Othello模型提供了不同的计算测试床,其范围必须伴随解释(Kissane等人,2024年;Menon等人,2024年;He等人,2024年a年)。 Neurons, heads, key - value 特征和功能词典为计算账户提供了替代单元(O ' Neill and Bui, 2024;Arora等人, 2026;Ye等人, 2025;Shafran等人, 2026;Dunefsky等人, 2024);比较应当确定SAE基础添加的内容.

blocks.en: Semantic interpretability rests on discriminating predictions, and utility on appropriate task comparisons. Mechanistic faithfulness requires evidence that the proposed variables and dependencies capture computation the original model uses. Controlled edits contribute to that assessment, but their success alone does not establish the claimed pathway. A feature can remain useful for control even when its mechanistic interpretation fails.
blocks.zh: 语义解释性取决于歧视性的预测,以及对适当任务比较的效用。 机械的忠实性要求有证据表明拟议变量和依赖性能够捕捉到计算原始模型使用的证据. 受控制的编辑有助于这一评估,但仅凭其成功并不能确定所主张的路径。 一个特性即使在其机械解释失败的情况下仍可用于控制.

blocks.en: 5 Comparing SAE Usefulness Across NLP Tasks
blocks.zh: 5 在NLP任务中比较SAE用途

blocks.en: RQ3 asks why NLP studies reach different conclusions about SAE usefulness. The comparison depends on what the task requires, what information the method receives, and which alternative it must outperform. We organize the findings around these differences to identify both useful contributions and the conditions under which their advantages hold. Appendix E provides extended comparisons.
blocks.zh: RQ3询问为什么NLP研究对SAE的有用性得出不同的结论. 比较取决于任务需要什么,方法得到什么信息,以及它必须超越哪种选择。 我们围绕这些差异整理调查结果,以确定有益的贡献及其有利条件。 附 录 E提供了扩展比较。

blocks.en: 5.1 Objectives change the value of a feature
blocks.zh: 5.1 国家 目标改变特性的价值

blocks.en: Language identity makes the role of the objective explicit. LangSAE removes language-associated components from pooled multilingual-e5 embeddings for semantic retrieval, whereas CLaS-Bench edits Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct activations to control the output language ( Kim et al., 2026 ; Gurgurov et al., 2026 ) . Suppressing language identity and strengthening it serve different goals. Their findings concern different task requirements.
blocks.zh: 语言特征使得目标的作用明确. 兰 SAE从集合多语种e5嵌入中去除语言相关组件,用于语义检索,而CLAS-Bench编辑Llama-31-8B-Instruct激活以控制输出语言(Kim等人,2026年;Gurgurov等人,2026年). 压制语言特征和加强语言特征有助于实现不同的目标。 他们的调查结果涉及不同的任务要求。

blocks.en: Within CLaS-Bench, residual difference-in-means scores 84.5 versus 42.3 for SAE difference-in-means, a 42.2-point gap in the combined language/relevance metric ( Gurgurov et al., 2026 ) . The reported selected settings use layers 20 and 25, respectively, both at strength 5. This establishes an advantage for the selected residual-space pipeline; differences in available layers and selection prevent isolating the SAE basis as the cause (Appendix F ).
blocks.zh: 在CLAS-Bench中,剩余值差异对SAE值差异的比分为84.5比42.3,在综合语言/关联度量中差距为42.2分(Gurgurov等人,2026年). 报告的选定设置分别使用第20层和第25层,均为强度5。 这为选定的剩余空间管道提供了优势;现有各层的差异和选择防止将SAE基础隔离为原因(附录F)。

blocks.en: Linguistic analysis asks a more specific question than language control. Language-associated groups support observation and intervention ( Deng et al., 2025 ) ; LinguaLens tests Chinese/English linguistic contrasts ( Jing et al., 2025 ) , while TenseLoC localizes tense and tests English-feature steering ( Tumurchuluun et al., 2025 ) . Script-sensitive representations motivate matched-content and transliteration controls, with raw-neuron interventions serving as a direct comparator ( Verma et al., 2026 ) . Italian-model analysis extends coverage ( Bondielli et al., 2025 ) . Together, these studies motivate testing whether corresponding features preserve a specified linguistic contrast and intervention effect across languages; broad language selectivity or geometric similarity alone does not establish that transfer.
blocks.zh: 语言分析提出了一个比语言控制更具体的问题. 语言相关团体支持观察和干预(Deng等人,2025年);Lingua 伦斯测试汉语/英语语言对比(Jing等人,2025年),而TenseLOC则将紧张度本地化,测试英语-feature direct(Tumurchulun等人,2025年). 脚本敏感表达激发了匹配内容和转写控制,原始中微子干预作为直接参照(Verma等人,2026年)。 意大利模式分析扩大覆盖范围(Bondielli等人,2025年)。 这些研究共同促使测试相应的特征是否保留了特定语言对比和跨语言的干预效果;广义语言选择性或几何相似性本身并不能确定这种转移.

blocks.en: 5.2 Representations and baselines define the comparison
blocks.zh: 5.2 说明和基线界定了比较

blocks.en: Classification provides a concrete reconciliation. Positive Gemma results compare SAE classifiers with last-token hidden-state baselines ( Gallifant et al., 2025 ) . In sparse probing, adding attention-pooled dense baselines reduces the apparent advantage of pooled SAE probes ( Kantamneni et al., 2025 ) . Both studies examine pooling, so its presence alone cannot explain their disagreement. The within-study comparison establishes that baseline construction matters; attributing all cross-paper differences to it would require matching the model, data, feature selection, and classifier. Task-aligned classification additionally changes representation training ( Bail et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 分类提供了具体的调和。 阳性Gemma结果将SAE分类器与最后一个托肯隐藏状态基线进行比较(Gallifant等人,2025年)。 在稀疏的探测中,增加集中注意力的密集基线降低了集合式SAE探测器的明显优势(Kantamneni等人,2025年)。 两项研究都研究了集合,因此单靠集合无法解释它们的分歧. 研究内部的比较确定基线建筑的重要性;将所有跨纸面差异归结于此,将需要匹配模型、数据、特征选择和分类器。 任务统一分类还改变了代表培训(Bail等人,2025年)。

blocks.en: DILA and topic modeling construct interpretable task systems ( Wu et al., 2024 ; Zheng et al., 2026 ) , rather than explaining an unchanged source model. Speech analysis, vision–language alignment, and multimodal tracing further change the representation being examined ( Pluth et al., 2026 ; Lee et al., 2026 ; DHIMOÏLA et al., 2026 ; Kaushik et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2026 ) . These extensions require comparisons appropriate to acoustic frames, visual embeddings, or text tokens.
blocks.zh: DILA和主题模型构建可解释的任务系统(Wu等人,2024;Zheng等人,2026),而不是解释一个不变的源模型. 语音分析、视觉-语言协调以及多式联运追踪进一步改变了正在审查的表述(Pluth等人,2026年;Lee等人,2026年;DHIMOÏLA等人,2026年;Kaushik等人,2026年;Yang等人,2026年)。 这些扩展需要与声框,视觉嵌入物,或文本符号相适应的比较.

blocks.en: 5.3 Information access separates RAG outcomes
blocks.zh: 5.3 信息获取将RAG结果分开

blocks.en: Retrieval-oriented objectives can preserve useful matching structure ( Kang et al., 2025 ) , while adapting a retriever around a frozen dictionary constructs a new retrieval system ( Formal et al., 2026 ) . For retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), improvements concern different stages: detecting unsupported output, choosing between context and memory, enriching a query, or repairing an answer. Table 2 distinguishes these operations and their information requirements. A detector can identify errors without explaining their cause, and increased reliance on context helps only when that context is trustworthy.
blocks.zh: 以检索为导向的目标可以保留有用的匹配结构(Kang等人,2025年),而围绕冻结词典对检索器进行改造则构建了一个新的检索系统(Formal等人,2026年). 对于检索增强生成(RAG),改进涉及不同的阶段:检测不支持的输出,选择上下文和内存,丰富查询,或修复一个答案. 表2对这些行动及其信息要求作了区分。 探测器可以在不解释其原因的情况下识别错误,只有当上下文可信时,对上下文的更多依赖才有帮助。

blocks.en: LatDefuse illustrates why information access belongs in the comparison. It optimizes latent edits toward a known correct token at answer divergence and evaluates distractor-vulnerable instances ( Giannetti et al., 2026 ) . The result establishes conditional repair capacity. Comparing its recovery rate directly with autonomous detection or correction would conflate different supervision and evaluation populations. An integrated system would need to evaluate detection, source arbitration, and repair together, including errors passed between stages.
blocks.zh: LatDefuse说明了为什么信息访问属于比较. 它在回答分歧时优化了潜在编辑方式,以找到一个已知的正确符号,并评价分散注意力的脆弱情况(Giannetti等人,2026年)。 结果确定了有条件的修理能力。 直接将其回收率与自主检测或纠正相比较,将使不同的监督和评价人群相互混为一谈。 综合系统需要共同评估检测、源仲裁和修复,包括各阶段之间发生的错误。

blocks.en: 5.4 Selection and prompts shape instruction gains
blocks.zh: 5.4 选择和提示形状指示增益

blocks.en: For reasoning, steering a strategy and identifying its computation are separate achievements. Reasoning-associated features can change traces or strategies ( Galichin et al., 2025 ; Fang et al., 2026 ) , while cue-injection and meaning-preserving tests can challenge an abstract-reasoning label ( Ma et al., 2026 ) . Temporal-difference analysis ties features to specified computational variables in an in-context reinforcement-learning task ( Demircan et al., 2025 ) . These findings answer different questions about control, feature meaning, and computation; lexical cues must be varied independently of the required operation to compare those claims.
blocks.zh: 就推理而言,指导一项战略和确定其计算是单独的成绩。 理性相关特征可以改变踪迹或策略(Galichin等人,2025年;Fang等人,2026年),而cue-注入和保留意义测试可以挑战抽象推理标签(Ma等人,2026年). 在内容内加固-学习任务中,Timoral-difference analysis与特定的计算变量相联系(Demircan等人,2025年)。 这些结论回答了关于控制、特征含义和计算的不同问题;必须独立于对索赔进行比较的必要操作而改变词汇提示。

blocks.en: Instruction methods also differ in how they select features: SAIF identifies instruction-related features ( He et al., 2025 ) , narrative editing generates compliant/violating contrasts ( Zhao et al., 2025a ) , SISTER uses prompt variation ( Cho and Hockenmaier, 2025 ) , and PULSE uses labeled demonstration utility ( Hao et al., 2026 ) . Comparators need access to the same signals. Evaluation prompts matter as well: for Gemma-2-2B sentiment circuits, SST-2 F1 gains are 37.19 points under template T1 and 2.96 under T4 ( Li et al., 2026b ) . These three-run mean differences establish prompt dependence within the reported setting; they do not isolate baseline headroom as its cause.
blocks.zh: 指令方法在选择特征时也有所不同:SAIF识别与指令相关的特征(He等人,2025年),叙事编辑生成符合/维化对比(Zhao等人,2025年a),SISTER使用即时变异(Cho和Hockenmaier,2025年),PULSE使用标注的演示功能(Hao等人,2026年). 比较者需要获得同样的信号. 评测也催生了物质:对于Gemma-2-2B情绪电路,SST-2 F1增益在模板T1下为37.19分,T4下为2.96分(Li等人,2026b). 这些三轮运行的差额在报告的环境下造成迅速依赖性;它们并不孤立基线头室作为其原因。

blocks.en: The stage of use changes the comparison further. Concept-based pretraining ( Tack et al., 2026 ) and feature-guided fine-tuning data selection ( Shi et al., 2026 ) construct changed models; transfer prediction ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) and sparse model diffing ( Kassem et al., 2025 ) respectively anticipate and diagnose updates. Inference-time activation or input edits leave weights fixed; diffusion-language analyses additionally depend on denoising time and mask position ( Wang et al., 2026b ) .
blocks.zh: 使用阶段进一步改变了对比. 基于概念的预训(Tack等人,2026年)和特征指导的微调数据选择(Shi等人,2026年)构建了变化模型;转移预测(Zhang等人,2026年b)和稀疏模型疏导(Kassem等人,2025年)分别预测和诊断更新. 推论时间激活或输入编辑会留下固定的权重;传播语言分析会额外依赖于去诺时间和口罩位置(Wang等人,2026b). 。 。 。

blocks.en: 5.5 Controllers determine regulation trade-offs
blocks.zh: 5.5 主计长决定条例的权衡

blocks.en: Behavioral regulation tests what the complete intervention achieves. Refusal-feature analysis and adversarial detection ( Yeo et al., 2025 ) concern different outcomes from maintaining benign capabilities during control. Static refusal amplification can impair unrelated capabilities ( O’Brien et al., 2024 ) ; REINS and graph-regularized steering combine selected directions with runtime gating ( Ding et al., 2026 ; Yeon et al., 2025 ) . Their comparison therefore involves both the feature directions and the decision about when to intervene.
blocks.zh: 行为调控检验了完全干预的成果. 拒绝特征分析和对抗检测(Yeo等人,2025年)涉及控制期间维持良性能力的不同结果。 静态拒绝放大可损害不相关的能力(O ' Brien等人,2024年);REINS和图态化方向将选定的方向与运行时间定位相结合(Ding等人,2026年;Yeon等人,2025年)。 因此,它们的比较既涉及特征方向,也涉及何时进行干预的决定。

blocks.en: Unlearning makes this distinction concrete. Static suppression has mixed multi-topic results ( Farrell et al., 2024 ) ; Dynamic SAE Guardrails add input-dependent classification ( Muhamed et al., 2025a ) , whereas subspace-guided projection and CRISP modify parameters ( Wang et al., 2025 ; Ashuach et al., 2026 ) . Conditional intervention can avoid unnecessary edits, while parameter updates remove dependence on a runtime controller. Comparing their forget–retain trade-offs requires matching target knowledge, evaluation populations, retention tasks, and relearning attacks. Adaptation constraints ( Wang et al., 2026a ; Peng et al., 2026 ) and backdoor analyses ( Zeng et al., 2026 ; Antoun et al., 2026 ) add further training and attack conditions. These differences identify what a controlled comparison must hold fixed before attributing a gain to the dictionary.
blocks.zh: 失学使这种区别变得具体。 静态抑制具有混合的多专题结果(Farrell等人,2024年);动态SAE Guardrails添加了依赖输入的分类(Muhamed等人,2025年a),而亚空间制导投影和CRISP修改参数(Wang等人,2025年;Ashuach等人,2026年). 有条件的干预可以避免不必要的编辑,而参数更新可以消除对运行时间控制器的依赖. 对比他们的忘却 — — 保持权衡需要匹配目标知识、评价人口、保留任务和再学习攻击。 适应约束(Wang等人,2026a;Peng等人,2026年)和后门分析(Zeng等人,2026年;Antoun等人,2026年)增加了进一步的训练和攻击条件. 这些差异表明,在将收益归于词典之前,控制下的比较必须固定什么。

blocks.en: SAE usefulness depends on the objective, representation, comparison baseline, available supervision, and intervention pipeline. Opposing treatments of language identity can both serve their respective tasks; classification, repair, and regulation results require matching the conditions defining success. The synthesis reconciles the scope of these findings. Establishing which factor causes a remaining performance difference requires experiments that vary it while controlling the others.
blocks.zh: SAE的有用性取决于目标、代表性、比较基线、现有监督和干预管道。 反对对语言特征的处理既能满足各自的任务;分类、修复和监管结果需要匹配确定成功的条件。 综合调和了这些发现的范围. 确定造成剩余性能差异的哪些因素需要进行实验,在控制其他因素的同时加以改变。

blocks.en: 6 Research Directions and Practical Choices
blocks.zh: 6 研究方向和实际选择

blocks.en: The answers to RQ1–RQ3 identify recovery bottlenecks, requirements for mechanistic claims, and conditions shaping task utility. They motivate experiments that distinguish competing explanations and guide the choice of an appropriate unit of analysis.
blocks.zh: 对RQ1-RQ3的答复查明了恢复瓶颈、对机械索赔的要求以及影响任务效用的条件。 它们激发了区分相互竞争的解释和指导选择适当分析单位的实验。

blocks.en: 6.1 Three testable comparisons
blocks.zh: 6.1 国家 三个可检验的比较

blocks.en: Compare static and temporal dictionaries with matched host model, layer, capacity, average sparsity, and training corpus ( Bhalla et al., 2026b ; Lubana et al., 2026 ) . Vary semantic continuity, lexical repetition, and abrupt discourse change independently. Measure held-out contrast discrimination and predicted intervention effects on entity/state tracking. This tests whether temporal structure captures discourse-relevant distinctions beyond lexical persistence; smooth codes and separate task gains would leave that relationship unresolved.
blocks.zh: 比较静态和时空词典与匹配的宿主模型、层、容量、平均孢子以及培训工具(Bhalla等人,2026b;Lubana等人,2026年)。 语义的连续性 词汇的重复 和突然的言语独立地改变 措施对实体/国家跟踪的差别和预期干预影响。 这一测试时间结构是否涵盖超出语法持久性的与话语相关的区别;平稳的代码和单独的任务收益将使这种关系得不到解决。

blocks.en: Match features across random seeds, paraphrases, and languages using geometry and activation distributions, then test whether correspondence predicts preservation of an independently specified intervention effect. Include unmatched and frequency-matched controls. Current consistency and matching measures ( Song et al., 2026 ; Cao et al., 2026 ) motivate these comparisons, while known-concept disentanglement results ( Mueller et al., 2026b ) motivate testing functional roles separately.
blocks.zh: 横跨随机种子的匹配特征,解码词,以及使用几何学和激活分布的语言,然后检验函证是否预测了独立指定的干预效果的保存. 包含无法匹配和频率匹配的控件. 目前的一致性和匹配度量衡(Song et al., 2026;Cao et al., 2026)激励了这些对比,而已知的概念分解结果(Mueller et al., 2026b)则激励了单独测试功能角色.

blocks.en: With fixed train/validation/test splits, cross SAE dictionaries with shared supervised or unsupervised selection rules and static or gated controllers. Include dense probes for prediction and direct-space directions for control, with matched labels and tuning budgets. Report the target–retention frontier. The probing/classification disagreement and conditional-control advances motivate this design; attributing their differences to selection or gating remains a hypothesis until those factors are controlled.

blocks.en: 6.2 Choosing when an SAE adds value
blocks.zh: 6.2 (中文(简体) ). 选择当 SAE 添加值时

blocks.en: For a known predictive target, begin with a well-tuned supervised probe and a matched label budget. For output control, include direct activation directions before incurring dictionary-training and feature-selection costs. For a localized computational hypothesis, neurons, heads, or a functional surrogate may provide the required unit. Direct comparators support these choices ( Ye et al., 2025 ; Arora et al., 2026 ; Shafran et al., 2026 ; Gurgurov et al., 2026 ) . An SAE is more compelling when a reusable, fine-grained feature vocabulary enables discovery, comparison across many questions, or a demonstrated specificity/cost advantage.

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en:
This survey focuses on sparse autoencoders for
mechanistic interpretability and their applications
to natural language processing. It does not aim
to comprehensively cover related developments
in sparse coding, disentangled representation
learning, or interpretability methods beyond SAEs.
Given the rapid evolution of this research area,
our synthesis reflects the literature available
within the survey’s defined scope.
Comparisons across studies are constrained by
differences in model architectures, datasets,
feature representations, and evaluation protocols.
Accordingly, our analyses emphasize the conditions
under which findings are supported rather than
establishing universal rankings of SAE methods.
The proposed taxonomy and evidence framework
provide a basis for future comparative evaluations,
including controlled experiments across NLP tasks.

blocks.en: C.2 Identifiability and the object represented
blocks.zh: C.2 可识别性和所代表的物体

blocks.en: The linear representation hypothesis concerns representing a concept through a direction or low-dimensional linear structure ( Park et al., 2024 ) . Superposition concerns encoding more features than available dimensions using overlapping directions. Neither assumption by itself guarantees that a particular learned dictionary uniquely recovers the intended concepts.
blocks.zh: 线性表示假说涉及通过方向或低维线性结构代表一个概念(Park等人,2024年). 超位涉及使用重叠方向编码比可用的维度更多的特性. 这两种假设本身都无法保证某个特定的学识字典能够单独恢复预期的概念。

blocks.en: A low reconstruction error means the selected codes reproduce activations under a metric. It does not guarantee that a unique dictionary is identifiable from that distribution. Permutation/scaling symmetries are elementary ambiguities; correlated or hierarchical factors can support substantively different decompositions. Ground-truth recovery is measurable in synthetic settings with a known generating dictionary. In a natural LM, semantic tests, controlled tasks, and functional comparisons provide partial constraints, rather than direct access to an agreed ground-truth feature inventory.
blocks.zh: 低重建错误是指选定的代码在一个度量下复制激活. 它不能保证从这种分发中可以识别出一个独特的词典。 持久性/规模化对称性是基本的模糊性;相关或等级因素可以支持实质上不同的分解. 用已知生成词典在合成环境中可以测量到地面真相的恢复。 在自然LM中,语义测试、受控任务和功能比较提供了部分限制,而不是直接获取商定的地面真实特征清单。

blocks.en: Splitting represents a nominal concept through multiple latents, sometimes at different granularities. Absorption occurs when a specialized feature also carries a more general property, so absence of the nominal general feature’s activation does not imply absence of that information ( Chanin et al., 2025 ) . Composition concerns how multiple factors combine to represent or compute a target; KronSAE’s factorized interactions implement a different assumption from either phenomenon ( Kurochkin et al., 2025 ) . Ablating one split coordinate may underestimate distributed involvement; ablating an absorbing coordinate can affect several semantic properties. These are reasons to inspect feature sets and their side effects, not to assume every feature group is a causal mechanism.
blocks.zh: 分化通过多种潜伏物,有时在不同颗粒物上,代表一种名义概念. 当某个专门特征也带有更一般的属性时,即发生吸收,因此没有名义上的一般特征的激活并不意味着没有这种信息(Chain等人,2025年)。 构成涉及多种因素如何结合来代表或计算一个目标;KronSAE的因子化相互作用执行了一个不同于两个现象的假设(Kurochkin等人,2025年)。 分解一个坐标可能会低估分布式参与;分解一个吸收坐标会影响几个语义属性. 这些是检查特征集及其副作用的原因,而不是假设每个特征组都是因果机制.

blocks.en: A multidimensional concept occupies a subspace or requires several coordinates ( Engels et al., 2025 ; Dalili and Mahdavi, 2026 ) . A concept manifold introduces continuous geometry that may be represented by global spanning features or local tiling ( Bhalla et al., 2026a ) . Matryoshka dictionaries couple nested reconstruction scales ( Bussmann et al., 2025 ) ; hierarchical gating models explicit parent–child dependence ( Muchane et al., 2025 ) ; cascaded SAE++ learns higher-level concepts over decoder directions ( Zhao et al., 2026 ) . These differences determine what an intervention on a node, group, prefix, or subspace means. The rate–distortion–polysemanticity model further shows why co-occurrence can change the preferred decomposition ( Mencattini et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 一个多层面的概念占据了一个子空间或需要几个坐标(Engels等人,2025年;Dalili和Mahdavi,2026年). 概念的多面性引入了连续几何,可能以全球横跨特征或局部板块为代表(Bhalla等人,2026a) 。 。 。 Matryoshka词典 夫妇筑巢重建尺度(Bussmann等人,2025年);分级成型模式 明确亲子依赖(Muchane等人,2025年);级联SAE++ 学习比解码器方向更高的概念 (赵等,2026). 这些差异决定了对节点,组,前缀或子空间的干预意味着什么. 速率-扭曲-polysemantity模型进一步表明,共同发生为何可以改变偏好分解(Mencattini等人,2026年).

blocks.en: C.3 Sequence, coverage, and computational site
blocks.zh: C.3 顺序、覆盖范围和计算地点

blocks.en: Temporal smoothness and predictable-context decomposition are different hypotheses about sequences ( Bhalla et al., 2026b ; Lubana et al., 2026 ) . The former favors slowly changing higher-level factors; the latter separates predictable information from novelty. Neither supplies semantic ground truth: repeated lexical forms can be temporally stable, and a linguistically important contrast can be predictable. A discourse experiment should independently vary semantic continuity, lexical repetition, and information novelty, measuring both feature organization and intervention effects.
blocks.zh: 时间光滑和可预测的文字分解是不同关于序列的假设 (Bhalla等人,2026b;Lubana等人,2026). 前者倾向于缓慢地改变较高层次的因素;后者将可预测的信息与新事物区分开来. 两者都不提供语义上的地面真理:重复的语法形式可以时间上稳定,语言上重要的对比是可以预测的. 论述实验应该独立地改变语义的连续性,词汇重复,以及信息新颖性,同时衡量特征组织和干预效果.

blocks.en: Coverage is an independent source of failure. A concept absent or extremely rare in the training activations cannot be recovered as reliably as one repeatedly represented in appropriate contexts. Specialized SAEs change sampling and risk weighting ( Muhamed et al., 2025b ) ; multilingual coverage adds language, script, tokenization, and construction-frequency imbalances. General-purpose and specialized dictionaries should be compared with their different data and supervision budgets visible. An apparent architectural advantage can otherwise be a coverage advantage.
blocks.zh: 覆盖范围是失败的一个独立来源。 在培训启动过程中不存在或极少出现的概念,无法像在适当情况下反复出现的概念那样可靠地恢复。 专门的SAE改变了取样和风险加权(Muhamed等人,2025年b);多语种覆盖增加了语言、文字、符号化和建筑频率不平衡。 普通用途和专门字典应与其不同的数据和监督预算进行比较。 否则,一个明显的建筑优势可能是覆盖优势。

blocks.en: Residual-stream SAEs characterize a mixed running state; attention-output SAEs expose context-dependent writes; MLP-output SAEs characterize another update to that state. A transcoder learns a sparse approximation to an input–output function, creating a different candidate causal object. A pooled-embedding SAE for retrieval collapses token position and belongs to a different representation level. Speech frames, visual tokens, and diffusion timestep/mask position introduce further indexing variables.
blocks.zh: 残余流式SAEs是混合运行状态的特点;注意力输出型SAEs暴露了上下文依赖的写法;MLP输出型SAEs是该状态的另一个更新特征. 转码器学习到一个输入-输出函数的稀疏近似值,生成一个不同的候选因果对象. 用于回收的集合集成SAE崩溃了符号位置,属于不同的代表级别. 语音帧,视觉符号,以及扩散时间步/任务位置都引入了进一步的索引变量.

Testing the disconnected and dormant components separately exposes the mismatch. This answers the question of whether causal validation is sufficient: an intervention is causal as a manipulation, but its success need not validate the proposed interpretation of the unmodified computation.

A null edit z ′ = z z^{\prime}=z then returns the original activation, while replacing it with the decoded reconstruction can alter the model before any intended edit occurs. This distinguishes reconstruction damage from the effect of the feature delta. It does not ensure that the edited state was naturally reachable. Large coefficients, incompatible coactivation, or simultaneous edits across sites can create off-manifold states.

blocks.en: Matched-norm random directions, naturally occurring replacement values, coefficient sweeps, retention tasks, and token-level effects probe different confounds. They should be selected for the claim rather than applied as an undifferentiated checklist. A failed off-target test may weaken specificity while leaving a target causal effect intact. A null necessity result can reflect redundant computation; it does not by itself prove irrelevance. Sufficiency is likewise conditional on the receiving context and intervention convention.
blocks.zh: 匹配-规范随机方向,自然发生的置换值,系数扫描,保留任务,以及符号级效应探测不同错位. 应当为索赔选定这些索赔,而不是作为不加区别的清单适用。 失败的离目标测试可能会削弱特异性,同时使目标因果效应保持不变. 无效的必要结果可以反映多余的计算;它本身并不证明是无关的。 充分性同样取决于接收情况和干预公约。

blocks.en: An edge in a circuit diagram should state its construction: activation correlation, geometric matching, gradient-based attribution, or intervention-confirmed dependence. These are not interchangeable. Attribution can prioritize candidate edges efficiently, while controlled removal/restoration and counterfactual tests assess whether the selected path supports the task. Transcoder reconstruction of a component function and SAE reconstruction of one state have different error terms; a circuit comparison must retain those differences.
blocks.zh: 电路图中的边缘应说明其构造:激活相关性、几何匹配、基于梯度的归属,或干预确认的依赖。 这些不能互换。 归属可以高效地确定候选边线的优先次序,而控制移除/恢复和反事实测试则评估所选路径是否支持任务. 一个组件函数的转码器重建和一个状态的SAE重建有不同的错误术语;电路比较必须保留这些差异.

blocks.en: E.1 Linguistic identity, grammatical variables, and transfer
blocks.zh: E.1 语言特征、语法变量和转移

blocks.en: The multilingual literature moves through several distinct objects. Language-associated groups ( Deng et al., 2025 ) concern broad selectivity and combined interventions. LinguaLens constructs counterfactual contrasts and tests ablation/enhancement on Llama-3.1-8B with OpenSAE checkpoints; its causal estimates depend on the selected examples and LLM-judged outcome ( Jing et al., 2025 ) . TenseLoC distinguishes locating an attention-output bottleneck from steering selected residual-stream SAE features ( Tumurchuluun et al., 2025 ) . Script-controlled analysis demonstrates why broad language associations may track writing systems; its raw-neuron interventions belong to a direct-comparator role ( Verma et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 多语种文献通过几个不同的对象移动. 与语言有关的团体(Deng等人,2025年)涉及广泛的选择性和综合干预。 LinguaLens用OpenSAE检查站构建反事实对比和测试Llama-3.1-8B的膨胀/增强;其因果估计取决于选定的例子和LLM判断的结果(Jing等人,2025年)。 TenseLOC区分了定位注意力输出瓶颈和引导选定的残留流SAE特性(Tumurchulun等人,2025年)。 脚本控制分析显示,为什么广义语言协会可以跟踪书写系统;其原始中微子干预属于直接比较者角色(Verma等人,2026年).

blocks.en: The comparison suggests an ordered set of questions, not an evidence hierarchy across papers. First identify what varies: language identity, script, tense, meaning, or discourse role. Then hold matched semantic content where possible, use minimal grammatical contrasts, and test paraphrase or transliteration when the claim predicts invariance. Finally assess whether a matched feature preserves the predicted intervention effect across languages. Vector similarity alone does not establish that equivalence.
blocks.zh: 比较表明,问题有次序,而不是文件上的证据等级。 首先确定不同之处:语言身份,脚本,紧张,意义,或讨论角色. 然后在可能时保持相应的语义内容,使用最低限度的语法对比,并在权利要求预测不一致时测试解释或转写。 最后评估一个匹配的特征是否保留了预测的跨语言干预效果. 单是矢量相似性并不能确定这种等同性。

blocks.en: Evidence from Italian models ( Bondielli et al., 2025 ) and the studied multilingual sets establishes broader coverage than English-only discovery. It does not justify an extrapolation to all low-resource languages or morphologically diverse systems. Tokenization, script, corpus frequency, and syntactic constructions can each change the learned decomposition. A useful next comparison samples these factors explicitly and reports per-language semantic and functional outcomes rather than only a macro-average.
blocks.zh: 来自意大利模型的证据(Bondielli等人,2025年)和被研究的多语种集比仅使用英语的发现建立了更广泛的覆盖范围. 它不能作为推断所有低资源语言或形态多样性系统的理由。 托肯化,脚本,命案频率,以及合成构造,可以分别改变所学的分解. 下一个有用的比较是明确抽样这些因素,并报告各语种的语义和功能结果,而不仅仅是宏观平均数。

blocks.en: E.2 Language identity as a target and as a nuisance
blocks.zh: E.2 语言特征作为目标和烦恼

blocks.en: LangSAE uses a frozen multilingual-e5-large encoder, mean-pooled 1,024-dimensional representations, and a TopK-style sparse dictionary; it removes language-associated components before normalized retrieval scoring ( Kim et al., 2026 ) . Its training construction draws on mMARCO and MIRACL in ten languages. The question is whether the edited representation preserves semantic query–document relations while reducing an unwanted language cue.
blocks.zh: LangSAE使用冷冻的多语种-e5大编码器,平均集合的1,024维表示器,以及TopK风格的稀疏词典;它会在正常检索评分前删除与语言相关的组件(Kim等人,2026年). 其培训建筑利用了MARCO和MIRACL的10种语言。 问题在于编辑的表示是否保留语义查询 - 文件关系,同时减少一个不想要的语言提示 。

blocks.en: CLaS-Bench instead studies output-language control in an autoregressive instruction model ( Gurgurov et al., 2026 ) . A language cue that is undesirable for language-invariant retrieval is now the target signal. The source compares direct residual methods, probes, and SAE-derived directions under method-specific settings. Its mean score combines language fidelity and response relevance, and SAE comparisons are limited to layers with available checkpoints. Consequently, the observed direct-space advantage does not isolate dictionary quality from layer availability and selection procedure. The common term “language feature” conceals these opposite objectives and different representation sites.
blocks.zh: CLAS-Bench转而在自转式教学模型中研究输出语言控制(Gurgurov等人,2026年). 一个语言提示对于语言不变量检索来说是不可取的,现在是目标信号. 该来源比较了直接残留方法,探针,以及方法特定设置下的SAE衍生方向. 其平均分数结合了语言忠诚度和反应相关性,SAE比较仅限于与可用检查站的分层. 因此,所观察到的直接空间优势并不将字典质量与图层可用性和选择程序隔离开来。 共同的“语言特征”一词掩盖了这些相反的目标和不同的代表网站。

blocks.en: E.3 Prediction versus construction in sparse classification
blocks.zh: E.3 少数分类的预测与建筑

blocks.en: Kantamneni et al. (2025) evaluate sparse probes on Gemma-2-9B with JumpReLU GemmaScope dictionaries, with a Llama-3.1-8B/TopK replication. They examine last-token and multi-token max-pooled representations, attention-pooled dense baselines, and feature binarization. Gallifant et al. (2025) use frozen Gemma-family models and public dictionaries, vary pooling and binarization, and train logistic regression with five-fold cross-validation. Their neural baseline uses last-token hidden states. Bail et al. (2025) instead align representations to classification tasks; their encoder-only and decoder-only models also use different extraction sites.
blocks.zh: Kantamneni等人(2025年)用JumpReLU GemmaScope词典对Gemma-2-9B上的稀疏探测器进行评估,并带有Llama-3.1-8B/TopK复制. 他们研究了最后的和多的集合式表述、集中注意力的密集基线和二进制特征。 Gallifant等人(2025年)使用冷冻的Gemma-family模型和公共词典,不同的集合和二进制,并用五倍的交叉验证来训练物流回归. 他们的神经基线使用最后的隐藏状态. 拜尔等. (2025年)相反,将表示与分类任务一致;它们的编码器唯一和解码器唯一模式也使用不同的提取点.

blocks.en: Source observation: the within-study baseline comparison in Kantamneni et al. (2025) reduces the apparent pooled-SAE advantage when attention-pooled dense probes are available. This provides direct evidence that baseline construction matters in that protocol. Survey interpretation: positive classification results and limited generic-probing gains need not contradict each other because the representation, aggregation, selected features, classifier, and baseline differ. It would be inaccurate to attribute the difference simply to one paper using pooling and the other omitting it. Nor does this comparison isolate the cause of every difference between Gallifant et al. (2025) ; Kantamneni et al. (2025) ; Bail et al. (2025) . A matched study should fix model, layer, dataset split, label and tuning budgets while varying pooling, feature selection, task alignment, and head capacity.
blocks.zh: 资料来源:Kantamneni等人的研究内基线比较。 (2025)在有集中注意力的密集探测器时,会降低明显的集合-SAE优势. 这直接证明了基线建设在该协议中的重要性。 调查解释:积极的分类结果和有限的通用试验收益不必相互矛盾,因为表述、汇总、选定特征、分类者和基线各不相同。 将差异仅仅归结到一份使用集合的文件中,而另一份则省略,是不准确的。 这一比较也没有孤立出Gallifant等人(2025年)、Kantamneni等人(2025年)、Bail等人(2025年)之间所有差异的原因。 一项匹配的研究应该固定模型、层、数据集的划分、标签和调整预算,同时不同的集合、特征选择、任务调整和头部能力。

blocks.en: E.4 RAG: detection, source arbitration, and oracle repair
blocks.zh: E.4 RAG:检测、源仲裁和甲骨文修复

blocks.en:
Table 2 summarizes the stage and information requirements underlying these comparisons.
Dense embedding decomposition ( O’Neill et al., 2024 ) and retrieval-oriented objectives ( Kang et al., 2025 ; Formal et al., 2026 ) can produce controllable representations. Query-expansion feature discovery selects 2,000 pairs that improve MRR@10 ( Dong et al., 2026 ) . The source also analyzes helpful, neutral, and harmful expansions (their Appendix B.2); this broader diagnostic analysis does not remove the success-conditioned selection of steering latents. SAFE integrates feature signals into query enrichment and subsequent generation ( Abdaljalil et al., 2025 ) . All of these are system-level contributions whose SAE-specific benefit requires a pipeline ablation.
blocks.zh:
表2概述了这些比较的阶段和信息要求。
Dense嵌入分解(O ' Neill等人,2024年)和面向检索的目标(Kang等人,2025年;Formal等人,2026年)可以产生可控的表示. Query-expansion特征发现选择了2000对改进MRR@10(Dong等人,2026年). 该资料来源还分析了有益的、中性的和有害的扩展(其附录B.2);这一更广泛的诊断分析并不能消除以成功为条件选择导电潜伏物。 SAFE将特征信号整合到查询浓缩和后续生成中(Abdaljalil等人,2025年). 所有这些都是系统层面的缴款,其针对最高审计实体的惠益需要管道削减。

blocks.en: HalluSAE and RAGLens predict hallucination-related outcomes ( Chen et al., 2026a ; Xiong et al., 2026 ) . RAGLens evaluates Llama2-7B/13B on RAGTruth and Dolly and tests additional model/dataset combinations; its detector and feedback stage are separate evaluations. Re-encoding through another backbone is not evidence that identical latent indices or meanings transfer. Sparse-latent source arbitration in Llama-3.1-8B ( Xin et al., 2025 ) and SPARE ( Zhao et al., 2025b ) instead changes reliance on context or internal knowledge. A proper correctness analysis must cross the intervention with whether each source is trustworthy.
blocks.zh: HaluSAE和RAGLens预测与幻觉有关的结果(Chen等人,2026a); Xiong等人,2026年). RAGLens在RAGTruth和Dolly上评价Llama2-7B/13B,并测试额外的模型/数据集组合;它的探测器和反馈阶段是单独的评价. 通过另一个主干进行重新编码,并不是同一潜在指数或意味着转移的证据。 Llama-3.1-8B中的Sparse-latent源仲裁 (Xin等人,2025年)和SPARE(Zhao等人,2025年b)转而改变对上下文或内部知识的依赖. 适当的正确性分析必须与每个来源是否可信相交叉。

blocks.en: LatDefuse selects distractor-vulnerable BioASQ, Natural Questions, and PopQA cases, then optimizes latent activations toward the known correct token at the first answer divergence ( Giannetti et al., 2026 ) . Both the host model and SAE remain frozen. The selected population contains approximately 255 instances per model, with gold context between two hard distractors. Its DCD/MDR decoding baselines also use oracle information—gold versus distractor document roles—but this is different from the correct-token optimization target. Source observation: optimized edits restore answers in this selected setting. Survey interpretation: this establishes conditional repair capacity, not autonomous error detection or correction; post-hoc feature labels do not uniquely identify a natural semantic mechanism. The source acknowledges supervision and semantic-interpretation limits. Its Llama naming remains inconsistent: its Section 4.1 and footnote 2 name Llama-3-8B, while its Table 1 and SAE checkpoint name Llama-3.1-8B. We retain that unresolved discrepancy in the ledger and use the unambiguous Gemma-2-2B setting for concrete model examples.
blocks.zh: LatDefuse选择分散注意力的易变生物ASQ、自然问题和PopQA案例,然后在第一个答案差异时优化潜在激活,以达到已知的正确信号(Giannetti等人,2026年)。 无论是主机型还是SAE都保持冻结. 选定的人群中,每个模型约有255个实例,两个硬分散器之间的黄金背景。 它的DCD/MDR解码基线也使用oracle信息——金色相对于分散文件角色——但这与正确的调试优化目标不同. 来源观察:优化编辑后在此选中的设置中恢复答案 。 勘察解释:这确立了有条件的修补能力,而不是自主的误差检测或校正;后热特征标签不独有地识别自然语义机制. 来文方承认监督和语义解释限制。 它的Llama命名仍然不一致:其第4.1节和脚注2名称为Llama-3-8B,而其表1和SAE检查站名称为Llama-3.1-8B. 我们保留了分类账中尚未解决的这一差异,并使用毫不含糊的Gemma-2-2B设定来作为具体示范实例。

blocks.en: E.5 Reasoning and instruction: labels, cues, and supervision
blocks.zh: E.5 联合国 理由和指导:标签、提示和监督

blocks.en: Reasoning steering ( Galichin et al., 2025 ; Fang et al., 2026 ) and reasoning-feature falsification ( Ma et al., 2026 ) concern different propositions. A feature can help induce a strategy while responding to a phrase rather than an abstract operation. Meaning-preserving rewrites and cue insertion test the semantic label; controlled reasoning tasks and targeted counterfactuals test the computational interpretation. Temporal-difference analysis supplies explicit reward/value/error variables in a specified in-context reinforcement-learning task ( Demircan et al., 2025 ) ; it should not be described as a temporal SAE architecture or as general evidence about chain-of-thought reasoning.
blocks.zh: 理性引导(Galichin等人,2025年;Fang等人,2026年)和推理-特性伪造(Ma等人,2026年)涉及不同的命题。 一个特性可以帮助诱导策略,同时响应一个短语而不是抽象操作. 意义保留重写和提示插入测试语义标签;控制推理任务和有针对性的反事实测试计算解释. 时间差异分析在具体内容中的强化学习任务(Demircan等人,2025年)中提供明确的奖励/价值/误差变量;它不应被描述为一个时间性SAE结构或作为思维链推理的一般证据。

blocks.en: For instruction following, generated compliant/violating narrative contrasts ( Zhao et al., 2025a ) , prompt-variation feature selection ( Cho and Hockenmaier, 2025 ) , instruction-associated latents ( He et al., 2025 ) , and labeled demonstration utility ( Hao et al., 2026 ) provide different information to the method. A comparison that grants a known target to one selector and only an unsupervised label to another does not isolate representation quality. In sentiment circuits, the same intervention has markedly different gains across prompt templates ( Li et al., 2026b ) ; this motivates reporting the prompt baseline as part of the method’s information and evaluation context.
blocks.zh: 对于后续指令,生成符合/活化的叙述对比(赵等人,2025a),即时变异特征选择(Cho和Hockenmaier,2025),与指令相关的潜伏(He等人,2025),以及标注的演示用途(Hao等人,2026),为方法提供了不同的信息. 比较让一个选择者获得已知目标,而只给另一个选择者获得不受监督的标签,并不孤立代表的质量。 在情绪循环中,同样的干预在即时模板(Li等人,2026年b)中的收益明显不同;这促使报告即时基线,作为方法信息和评价背景的一部分。

blocks.en: CoCoMix changes pretraining by predicting and interleaving SAE-derived concepts ( Tack et al., 2026 ) ; IGDS selects fine-tuning data using feature recall and intervention-based relevance ( Shi et al., 2026 ) . Transfer prediction uses pre-update signals ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) , whereas MNEME diagnoses changes after an update ( Kassem et al., 2025 ) . These stages have distinct prediction targets and access to labels or updated weights. Input optimization and inference-time activation edits are not weight adaptation. Diffusion-language work additionally conditions its feature interpretation on timestep and mask state ( Wang et al., 2026b ) .
blocks.zh: CoCoMix通过预测和互换SAE衍生概念来改变预训(Tack等人,2026年);IGDS利用特征召回和基于干预的相关性选择微调数据(Shi等人,2026年). 转移预测使用更新前的信号(Zhang等人,2026b),而MNEME在更新后诊断变化(Kassem等人,2025年). 这些阶段有不同的预测目标,可以访问标签或更新的权重. 输入优化和推断时间激活编辑不是重量适应. 传播语言在时间步和口罩状态上还附加了它的特性解释条件(Wang等人,2026年b).

blocks.en: E.6 Safety and unlearning: location, conditionality, persistence
blocks.zh: E.6 安全和不学习:地点、条件、持久性

blocks.en: Feature discovery, adversarial detection, and control should be extracted as separate claims. Constant refusal amplification has an observable target/benign-utility trade-off ( O’Brien et al., 2024 ) . REINS uses harmful-feature suppression, refusal enhancement, and gating on Qwen3.5 base models ( Ding et al., 2026 ) ; graph-regularized steering also combines structured directions with a runtime decision ( Yeon et al., 2025 ) . These are composite controllers, so an improvement over static steering need not be an improvement in feature semantics.
blocks.zh: 特征发现、对抗性探测和控制应作为单独索赔提取。 持续的拒绝扩大具有可观察到的目标/效益权衡(O ' Brien等人,2024年)。 REINS使用有害的地貌抑制,拒绝增强,并在Quen3.5基模型上配位(Ding等人,2026年);图态化方向还结合了结构化方向和运行时间决定(Yeon等人,2025年). 这些是复合控制器,所以相对于静态方向的改进不需要是特征语义的改进.

blocks.en: Early SAE unlearning evaluates selected knowledge and has mixed multi-topic results ( Farrell et al., 2024 ) . Dynamic SAE Guardrails use Gemma-2-2B-it with a layer-3 residual SAE and input-dependent feature statistics ( Muhamed et al., 2025a ) . SSPU and CRISP change parameters using SAE-derived constraints ( Wang et al., 2025 ; Ashuach et al., 2026 ) . The former runtime gate can avoid acting on unrelated inputs; persistent parameter changes eliminate that particular runtime dependency but create a different forgetting/retention and relearning problem. We compare where the change resides and what information selects it; a pooled ranking across unmatched benchmark denominators would hide these differences.
blocks.zh: 早期的SAE unlearning评价选定的知识,并具有混合的多专题成果(Farrell等人,2024年). 动态SAE Guardrails使用Gemma-2-2B-it,带有第3层剩余SAE和依赖输入的特性统计(Muhamed等人,2025年a) 。 。 。 SSPU和CRISP使用SAE衍生的制约参数(Wang等人,2025年;Ashuach等人,2026年). 以前的运行时间门可以避免在不相关的输入上采取行动;持续的参数变化消除了特定的运行时间依赖性,但造成了不同的遗忘/保留和再学习问题. 我们比较变化的发生地点和选择何种信息;对无法比拟的基准分母进行综合排名会掩盖这些差异。

blocks.en: Reward modeling ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) , low-rank adaptation ( Wang et al., 2026a ) , and coupled constraints during fine-tuning ( Peng et al., 2026 ) construct interpretable or constrained training systems. Emergent-misalignment geometry ( Minegishi et al., 2026 ) , medical-bias steering ( Ayadi and Hautli-Janisz, 2026 ) , and fine-grained safety resources ( Weng et al., 2026 ) add domain-specific diagnostic and control targets. Backdoor analyses find different roles for trigger detection, propagation, and output control across attack constructions and sites ( Zeng et al., 2026 ; Antoun et al., 2026 ) . These results motivate reporting the attack and benign population, not extrapolating a narrow diagnostic success to general safety.
blocks.zh: 奖励建模(张等,2025年),低档改造(王等,2026a),微调期间的结合制约(彭等,2026年)构建可解释或受约束的培训体系. 紧急-误差几何(Minegishi等人,2026年),医疗-比亚斯方向(Ayadi and Hautli-Janisz, 2026年),以及细纹安全资源(Weng等人, 2026年)都增加了特定域的诊断和控制目标. 后门分析发现,在攻击建筑和场地的触发探测、传播和产出控制方面,可以发挥不同的作用(Zeng等人,2026年;Antoun等人,2026年)。 这些结果促使人们报告袭击和良性人口,而不是将狭隘的诊断成功推向一般安全。

blocks.en: E.7 Text analytics, speech, and multimodal extensions
blocks.zh: E.7 联合国 文本分析、语音和多式联运扩展

blocks.en: Company similarity ( Molinari et al., 2025 ) , artificial-text detection ( Kuznetsov et al., 2025 ) , medical coding ( Wu et al., 2024 ) , classification ( Bail et al., 2025 ) , and topic modeling ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) use sparse features to construct or explain task systems. Watermark sampling ( Yu et al., 2025 ) and text-based confounding adjustment ( Zhong et al., 2026 ) have still different targets. In the latter, causal adjustment concerns an external data-generating question, not necessarily the language model’s internal causal mechanism. These studies remain in the map to mark the boundary between interpretable system construction and source-model explanation.
blocks.zh: 公司相似性(Molinari等人,2025年),人工文字检测(Kuznetsov等人,2025年),医学编码(Wu等人,2024年),分类(Bail等人,2025年),专题建模(郑等人,2026年)使用稀疏的特征构建或解释任务系统. 水印采样(Yu等人,2025年)和文字混杂调整(Zhong等人,2026年)仍然有不同的目标. 在后一种情况下,因果关系调整涉及一个外部数据生成问题,不一定是语言模型的内部因果关系机制。 这些研究保留在地图中,以标出可解释的系统构建与源模型解释之间的界限.

blocks.en: Whisper analysis operates on acoustic encoder frames rather than text-token residual states ( Pluth et al., 2026 ) . Cross-modal feature heterogeneity, energy alignment, and group-sparse dictionaries test how text and visual representations share or separate concepts ( Lee et al., 2026 ; DHIMOÏLA et al., 2026 ; Kaushik et al., 2026 ) . Hierarchical CLIP features and cascaded SAE++ introduce further structural objects ( Zaigrajew et al., 2025 ; Zhao et al., 2026 ) ; multimodal circuit tracing models input–output dependencies using transcoders ( Yang et al., 2026 ) . A semantic label can be shared while directions or causal roles differ, so text-only geometric conclusions do not transfer automatically.
blocks.zh: Whisper analysis 运行在声学编码器框架上,而不是文本键残基状态(Pluth 等人,2026年). 跨模式特征的异质性,能量对齐,以及组谱词典测试文本和视觉表现如何分享或分离概念(Lee等人,2026年;DHIMOQLA等人,2026年;Kaushik等人,2026年). 分级CLIP特征和级联的SAE++引入了更多的结构对象(Zaigrajew等人,2025年;Zhao等人,2026年);使用转码器的多式联运电路追踪模型输入-输出依赖性(Yang等人,2026年)。 在方向或因果角色不同时可以共享一个语义标签,因此仅文本几何结论不会自动转移.

blocks.en: Other extensions construct systems: sparse-feature distribution matching selects image-caption training data ( Das et al., 2026 ) , concept coverage guides token pruning ( Li et al., 2026c ) , and caption-conditioned masks alter visual representations for retrieval ( Mahajan et al., 2026 ) . Representation analysis motivates multimodal retrieval realignment ( Feng et al., 2026 ) ; text-derived visual steering also contains non-SAE alternatives, whose gains must not be attributed wholly to SAEs ( Gan et al., 2026 ) . These cases test representation portability and objective dependence, while their specific accuracy or retrieval outcomes remain modality- and protocol-dependent.
blocks.zh: 其他扩展构建系统: 稀疏的分布匹配选择图像封装训练数据(Das等人, 2026年) , 概念覆盖指导符号搜索(Li等人, 2026年c) , 字幕条件化的口罩改变可检索的视觉表达(Mahajan等人, 2026年) . 代表性分析推动了多模式检索调整(Feng等人,2026年);文本衍生的视觉引导还包含非SAE替代品,其收益不能完全归因于SAEs(Gan等人,2026年)。 这些案例检验表现的可移植性和客观依赖性,而其具体的准确性或检索结果仍然取决于方式和协议。

blocks.en: Appendix F Secondary Analyses of Published Results
blocks.zh: 附录F 中学 对公布结果的分析

blocks.en: The numerical panels were selected because each source supplies a within-study contrast relevant to a different part of the argument: changing the prompt while holding the intervention family fixed, and changing the representation/control method under a language-steering benchmark. They are illustrative mechanism-of-comparison cases, not a representative meta-analysis. The source results are replotted in Figure 5 ; our additions are subtraction of percentage-point differences and their interpretation in the taxonomy. We run no new model experiments.
blocks.zh: 选择数字面板是因为每个来源都提供与论点不同部分有关的研究内对比:在将干预家庭固定下来的同时改变提示,在语言测试基准下改变代表/控制方法。 它们是比较案例的说明机制,而不是一种有代表性的元分析。 来源结果在图5中重排;我们增加的数值减去百分点差异及其分类法的解释。 我们没有进行新的模型实验。

blocks.en: Figure 5: Published within-study results, replotted for two distinct comparisons. Left: Gemma-2-2B SST-2 F1 under four templates and sentiment-circuit amplification ( Li et al., 2026b ) ; three-run means are reported without dispersion in the extracted table. Right: mean CLaS-Bench language-steering score for Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct over 32 languages ( Gurgurov et al., 2026 ) . Different tasks, metrics, and selection protocols prohibit a cross-panel ranking.
blocks.zh: 图5:公布的学习内部结果,为两种不同的比较重新编制。 左侧:Gemma-2-2B SST-2 F1在四个模板和感应电路扩增(Li等人,2026b)下;在提取的表格中报告三种运行手段没有分散. 右:意为CLAS-Bench语言调图得分,为Llama-3.1-8B语言32种语言的指令(Gurgurov等人,2026年). 不同的任务,度量衡和选择协议禁止跨小组排名.

blocks.en: F.1 Sentiment and prompt dependence
blocks.zh: F.1 情绪和迅速依赖

blocks.en: The left panel of Figure 5 contrasts baseline and intervention scores under the four prompts. Li et al. (2026b) report baseline F1 of 45.29, 68.53, 80.33, and 86.43 for templates T1–T4, and intervention F1 of 82.48, 83.52, 86.61, and 89.39. Their differences are 37.19, 14.99, 6.28, and 2.96 percentage points . These are absolute differences, not relative percentage improvements.
blocks.zh: 图5的左侧面板对比了基线和四个音符下的干预分数. Li等人(2026年b)报告说,模板T1-T4的基准F1为45.29、68.53、80.33和86.43,干预F1为82.48、83.52、86.61和89.39。 它们之间的差别是37.19、14.99、6.28和2.96个百分点。 这些是绝对差异,而不是相对百分比的提高。

blocks.en: The reported results concern the Gemma-2-2B setting; Llama-3.1-8B results are separate. GemmaScope 16k dictionaries with average ℓ 0 \ell_{0} nearest 100 cover residual, MLP, and attention sites. The sentiment circuit is derived from SST-2, with node/edge thresholds 0.073/0.007. Strength is calibrated on contrastive validation data to target a logit-margin gain of 2.0 and is capped at 3. Evaluation selects the label using first output-token logits, without free-generation decoding. The source’s “zero-shot” label refers to prompting; it does not imply unsupervised circuit discovery or strength selection. Observation: the three-run mean F1 differences vary across T1–T4. Interpretation: useful gains are prompt-conditioned in this setting; differences in baseline quality and remaining headroom are not isolated causal explanations. The extracted results supply no dispersion, so no error bars or significance tests are added.
blocks.zh: 所报告的结果涉及Gemma-2-2B设定;Llama-3.1-8B结果是分开的。 GemmaScope 16k字典,平均为l 0\ell\\0}最近的100个覆盖剩余,MLP,和关注地点. 感应电路源于SST-2,其节点/对接阈值为0.073/0.007. 强度在对比性验证数据上进行校准,以对数-边距增益2.0为目标,并上限为3。 评价使用第一个输出端对数选择标签,不使用自由生成解码. 消息来源的 " 零射 " 标签是指提示;并不意味着无监督的电路发现或强度选择。 观察:T1–T4的三跑平均F1差异不同. 解释:在此设定中迅速获得有益的收益;基线质量和其余头室的差异不是孤立的因果关系解释。 提取的结果不提供散射,因此没有添加错误条或意义测试.

blocks.en: F.2 Language steering and direct-space alternatives
blocks.zh: F.2 语言指导和直接空间替代

blocks.en: The right panel of Figure 5 complements the objective comparison in Appendix E.2 with a within-benchmark contrast between intervention pipelines. Gurgurov et al. (2026) report mean language-steering scores of 67.7 for English prompts, 67.3 for target-language prompts, 84.5 for residual difference-in-means, 48.6 for a linear probe, 15.1 for PCA, 42.3 for SAE difference-in-means, 23.6 for LDA, and 80.1 for LAPE. Figure 5 (right) selects the two prompt baselines and two difference-in-means representations; the numerical-analysis page of the online register retains all eight values. The residual-minus-SAE difference is 42.2 score points.
blocks.zh: 图5的正确面板补充了附录E.2中的客观比较,与干预管道之间的基准内对比。 Gurgurov等人(2026年)的报告表明,语言测试的分数为:英语的67.7分,目标语言的67.3分,剩余差值的84.5分,线性探测器的48.6分,五氯苯甲醚的15.1分,SAE差值的42.3分,LDA的23.6分,LAPE的80.1分。 图5(右方)选择两个即时基线和两个异义表示;在线登记册的数字分析页保留所有8个值. 剩余-减去-SAE的差额为42.2分.

blocks.en: The language-steering score is the harmonic mean LSS = 2 ​ LFS ​ OR / ( LFS + OR ) \mathrm{LSS}=2\,\mathrm{LFS}\,\mathrm{OR}/(\mathrm{LFS}+\mathrm{OR}) , reported on a 0–100 scale: LFS is the target-language success fraction measured with FastText language identification; OR is normalized 0/1/2 relevance scored by Qwen-3-8B. The reported scores average over 32 languages on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct. The selected settings use residual DiffMean at layer 20 and SAE DiffMean at layer 25, both with strength 5, based on the source’s ablations. We retain these reported settings; the conflicting prose setting is recorded in Case G . SAE checkpoints exist only at layers 4, 12, 18, 20, and 25. The SAE intervention adds the reconstruction-error residual back after decoding; its gap cannot simply be attributed to replacing the hidden state with a lossy reconstruction. Observation: residual DiffMean has the higher reported score. Interpretation: this supports the complete selected pipeline in this benchmark, without isolating reconstruction error, language coverage, or dictionary quality as its cause. Neither equal layer coverage/compute nor an independent held-out tuning protocol is inferred. No uncertainty or significance estimate is reconstructed from the means.
blocks.zh: 语言调制的分数是谐调平均值LSS = 2 LFS OR / (LFS + OR )\mathrm{LSS}=2\,\mathrm{LFS}\,\mathrm{OR}/(\mathrm{LFS}+\mathrm{OR}),以0–100的比例报告: LFS是用FastText语言识别来测量的目标语言成功分数;OR是Qwen-3-8B得分的0/1/2相关性正常化. Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct上报告的32种语言的平均得分。 所选的设置使用第20层的剩余DiffMean和第25层的SAE DiffMean,两者都根据源的调值使用强度5。 我们保留了这些报道的设置;在案例G中记录了相互冲突的传言设置。 SAE检查站只存在于4、12、18、20和25层。 SAE干预在解码后添加了重建-错误残余;其缺口不能简单地归结为以损失的重建取代隐藏状态. 观察:剩余DiffMean的得分报告较高. 解释:这支持本基准中所选的完整管道,不将重建错误,语言覆盖,或词典质量隔离作为原因. 既无相等的层覆盖/计算,也无独立的挂载调试协议。 没有任何不确定因素或意义估计是从手段中重建的。

blocks.en: F.3 Selected denominators in unlearning and repair
blocks.zh: F.3 某些未学习和修理分母

blocks.en: Farrell et al. (2024) evaluate WMDP-Bio questions answered correctly under all 24 answer-option permutations: 172 of 1,273 for Gemma-2B-it and 522 for Gemma-2-2B-it. This targets reliably available knowledge rather than the entire benchmark population. LatDefuse similarly conditions on distractor-vulnerable cases and a known correct token ( Giannetti et al., 2026 ) . Their rates therefore cannot be pooled with full-benchmark or autonomous-system accuracy. We retain the selected denominators as part of the claim rather than treating them as generic limitations detached from the comparison.
blocks.zh: Farrell等人(2024年)在所有24个答案-选项表下正确评价了大规模毁灭性武器P-Bio问题:Gemma-2B-it为1 273个,Gemma-2-B-it为522个。 目标是可靠的现有知识,而不是整个基准人口。 LatDefuse对可分散注意力的案件和已知的正确标志也有类似条件(Giannetti等人,2026年)。 因此,不能以完整的基准或自主系统的准确性来汇集其费率。 我们保留了选定的分母,作为索赔的一部分,而不是把它们当作与比较分离的一般限制。

blocks.en: F.4 Capacity allocation and synthetic recovery
blocks.zh: F.4 能力分配和合成回收

blocks.en: This comparison expands the coverage-sensitive result in Table 5 ; the online evidence ledger supplies the source locator for Case G . Chen et al. (2026b) use 128 generating features in 42 dimensions and an 8,192-unit SAE; half the normalized samples sum three features and half sum 20. The source clarifies that sample sparsity varies but marginal feature frequencies are uniform , f = ( 3 + 20 ) / ( 2 ⋅ 128 ) ≈ 0.09 f=(3+20)/(2\cdot 128)\approx 0.09 . Full-coverage GBA uses ten target-frequency groups spanning 0.001–0.5; misspecified coverage uses ten groups spanning 0.001–0.01, excluding f f . At alignment threshold 0.9, TopK with K = 20 , 30 , 50 K=20,30,50 recovers 98.4%, 24.2%, and 23.4%; full/misspecified GBA recover 100%/3.9%. Results at the 0.8 threshold differ. Observation: recovery changes with these settings. Interpretation: this is sensitivity to sparsity allocation and target-frequency coverage in a known synthetic model, not evidence about long-tail linguistic recovery or NLP accuracy.
blocks.zh: 这一比较扩大了表5对覆盖面敏感的结果;在线证据分类账提供了案件G的来源定位器。 Chen等人(2026年b)在42维使用128个生成特征和一个8,192个单元的SAE;一半的归一化样本总和3个特征,一半总和20. 来源澄清说,样本的抽筋程度各不相同,但边缘特征频率是统一的,f=(3+20)/(2+128) ^ 0.09 f=(3+20)/(2\cdot 128)\ 0.09。 完全覆盖的GBA使用10个跨越0.001-0.5的目标频率组;错误的覆盖使用10个跨越0.001-0.01的组,不包括f. 在对齐阈值0.9下,TopK与K=20,30,50K=20,30,50恢复98.4%,24.2%,23.4%;满/错的GBA恢复100%/3.9%. 0.8阈值的结果各不相同。 观察:恢复随这些设置而改变。 解释:这是在已知合成模型中对孢子分配和目标频率覆盖的敏感性,而不是长尾语言恢复或NLP精度的证据.

blocks.en: Appendix G Selected Source-Level Evidence Cases
blocks.zh: 附录G 来源级证据案件

blocks.en: The six cases below document the observations underlying the recovery, semantic-validation, and NLP comparisons. Original case identifiers link them to the complete 28-case ledger in the online register (Appendix A ), which retains detailed extraction fields, source locators, and source-version hashes. Each case separates the published result from our interpretation.
blocks.zh: 以下6个案例记录了恢复、语义验证和NLP比较所依据的观测结果。 原始案例标识符将其链接到在线登记册(Appendix A)中完整的28个案例分类账,该分类账保留了详细的提取字段,源位定位器和源版本散列. 每起案件都把公布的结果与我们的解释分开。

blocks.en: Source and setting: Chen et al. (2026b) : a synthetic dictionary with uniform marginal feature frequencies and variable sample sparsity (Appendix F.4 ). Observation: at alignment threshold 0.9, TopK recovery is 98.4/24.2/23.4% for K = 20 / 30 / 50 K=20/30/50 ; GBA reaches 100% with full target-frequency coverage and 3.9% when coverage excludes the generating frequency. Interpretation: sparsity allocation and specified frequency coverage change recovery in this known model. The comparison does not measure long-tail linguistic recovery or NLP accuracy.
blocks.zh: 资料来源和设定: 陈等(2026b): 具有统一边际特征频率和可变样本螺纹的合成词典(附录F.4 )。 观察:在0.9对齐阈值下,TopK的回收率为98.4/24.2/23.4%,K=20 / 30 / 50 K=20/30/50;GBA达到100%,完全目标频率覆盖,而当覆盖率排除生成频率时则为3.9%. 解释:在本已知模型中,螺旋分布和指定频率覆盖变化恢复. 比较不测量长尾语言恢复或NLP精度.

blocks.en: Source and setting: Gurgurov et al. (2026) : CLaS-Bench on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct across 32 languages (Appendix F.2 ). Observation: residual and SAE DiffMean score 84.5 and 42.3. The reported selected settings use layers 20/25, respectively, with strength 5; the source prose instead gives an SAE peak at strength 15. This discrepancy remains unresolved. Interpretation: the result favors the selected residual pipeline; it does not isolate dictionary quality from selection and available layers. The SAE edit restores the reconstruction residual, excluding simple reconstruction replacement as an explanation of the gap.
blocks.zh: 资料来源和设定: Gurgurov等人(2026年):Llama-3.1-8B上的CLAS-Bench——32种语言的指令(附录F.2.). 观察:剩余和SAE DiffMean得分分别为84.5和42.3. 所报道的选定设置分别使用第20/25层,强度为5;取而代之的是源导词给出了15级的SAE峰值. 这一差异仍未解决。 解释:结果有利于选定的剩余管道;它不会将字典质量与选择和可用的层隔离开来. SAE编辑恢复重建剩余,不包括简单的重建替换作为差距的解释.

blocks.en: Source and setting: Kantamneni et al. (2025) : Gemma-2-9B/JumpReLU GemmaScope, with a Llama-3.1-8B/TopK replication. Observation: providing attention-pooled dense probes reduces the apparent advantage of max-pooled SAE probes; the source also examines binarization. Interpretation: baseline construction matters within this protocol. Both compared classification studies examine pooling, so its mere presence cannot reconcile their findings. Appendix E.3 separates the remaining differences in representation, feature selection, supervision, and classifier capacity.
blocks.zh: 资料来源:Kantamneni等人(2025年): Gemma-2-9B/倾角LU GemmaScope,带有Llama-3.1-8B/TopK复制机. 观测:提供集中式密集探测器会减少最大集中式SAE探测器的明显优势;源头也会检查二进制. 解释:本议定书范围内的基线建筑事项。 两项比较的分类研究都研究了集合,因此仅仅存在集合并不能调和它们的调查结果. 附录E.3将代表性、特征选择、监督和分类能力方面的其余差异分开。

blocks.en: Source and setting: Giannetti et al. (2026) : frozen models and dictionaries, approximately 255 distractor-vulnerable examples per model (Appendix E.4 ). Observation: optimizing latents toward the correct token recovers answers in this selected population. DCD/MDR comparators instead use oracle document roles. Gemma-2-2B is unambiguous; Llama model naming differs between methods and result labels. Interpretation: these results establish answer-conditioned repair capacity. They do not evaluate autonomous detection/correction, and post-hoc feature labels do not uniquely identify the natural mechanism.
blocks.zh: 资料来源和设定:Giannetti等人(2026年):冷冻模型和词典,每个模型大约255个可分散注意力的实例(附录E.4)。 观察:优化对正确标志的潜在作用,可以恢复这些特定人群的答案。 DCD/MDR比较器则使用甲骨文文件角色. Gemma-2-2B是毫不含糊的;Llama模型命名方法与结果标签不同. 解释:这些结果建立了满足条件的修复能力. 它们不评价自主的检测/校正,而后热功能标签不独有地识别自然机制.

blocks.en: Source and setting: Li et al. (2026b) : Gemma-2-2B, SST-2, GemmaScope dictionaries, validation-calibrated circuit amplification, and first-output-token classification (Appendix F.1 ). Observation: three-run mean F1 gains across T1–T4 are 37.19, 14.99, 6.28, and 2.96 percentage points. Interpretation: the measured benefit is prompt-dependent; baseline headroom is not isolated as its cause. Zero-shot prompting does not imply unsupervised circuit discovery or strength selection. The extracted means provide no dispersion for significance testing.
blocks.zh: 资料来源和设定: Li 等人(2026年b): (中文(简体) ). Gemma-2-2B, SST-2, Gemma (英语). 范围字典,验证校准电路拓扑,以及第一输出-托肯分类(Appendix F.1 ). 观察:T1-T4的3个运行平均F1增益为37.19,14.99,6.28和2.96个百分点. 解释:衡量的好处是迅速的;基线头室不是孤立的。 零镜头提示并不意味着无人监督的电路发现或强度选择. 抽取的手段不会分散进行意义测试。

blocks.en: Source and setting: Ma et al. (2025) , methods on feature sampling, explanation, activation simulation, and revision: selected features from Gemma-2-9B, Llama-3.1-8B, and GPT-2 Small, assessed with held-out and synthetic tests. Observation: mismatches between description-predicted and observed activation reveal failures in initial explanations and guide revisions. Interpretation: this supports a falsifiable description workflow. Description accuracy does not establish a computational role, consistent with the claim distinctions in Table 1 and Appendix D .
blocks.zh: 资料来源:Ma等人(2025年),关于特征取样、解释、激活模拟和修订的方法:Gemma-2-9B、Llama-31-8B和GPT-2 Small的选定特征,经搁置试验和合成试验评估。 观察:描述预测和观察到的激活之间的不匹配揭示了初始解释和指南修改中的失败. 解释:这支持可伪造的描述工作流程. 描述准确性没有确定与表1和附录D中的索赔区分相一致的计算作用。
